title: Paula L NDE 6045
content: Since I was a child I could astral project while I was awake. I did this in class and at home. I had no idea why, and I wondered if other kids also did this or could do this, although I did not tell anyone. I ended up in a violent relationship with the father of my children. I have four children. He was very violent. I was in this situation for 17 years. I finally got out. When I did, I had a hard time functioning. As a result of this, I tried to commit suicide. When this happened, I found myself astral projecting and then I could see a strong light. The feeling I was having when I looked at the light was of complete love and happiness. I then went through the light. I could see people at the end of the light that I recognized, but I couldn't get close enough to know who they were. I knew I did not want to come back to Earth. I knew I had died. I then felt the paddles on my chest that they use in the hospital to re-start your heart. I could hear someone in my left ear telling me' I love you Paula, you have to go back.' It was a man's voice. To this day, I do not know who this was. I then woke up in the hospital and I was so angry I did not die. I did not want to leave where I thought I was, in Heaven. I did not wake up for 3 days. After, I was in a semi coma and I could remember what happened in past lives. I remember I have lived before (in another life) and I had drowned. I know what it feels like to drown. I do not know who I was or where I lived but I know I drowned before. I am sure of this. Also since this happened I can see the future. I had the police come to my door asking me how I knew of a man who was killed on the next street. I told them I dreamed it. They brought me to the police station and I told them my dream. I found out the dream had actually happened. I wrote a statement saying who had done it and how it happened. It was all true. The police believed me. They said everything I just told them has happened and they have the three people in custody in the cell room down the hall. I went home. Then I noticed I could see where children were when they went missing. I can also feel if there is a spirit around me. I can also see the future. I get a strong feeling about things, and then they happen. I have tried to astral project since all this happened and I can still do this, but not like I could as a child and not as easily as I did as a child. I find that most of my life I spend trying to understand what has happened to me, why I see and feel this now after the accident. I read and watch a lot of things on the paranormal. I find I am very interested in life after death.

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw people at the end of the light that were recognized but could not get close enough to identify; heard an unknown male voice saying, 'I love you Paula, you have to go back.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Unknown male voice told her, 'I love you Paula, you have to go back.'
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt defibrillator paddles on her chest; then woke up in hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Past-life memory recall during semi-coma after waking; long-standing pre-NDE astral projection as a child.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/astral projection followed by seeing strong light, going through it, perceiving recognized people at the end of the light, then return triggered with defibrillator paddles and a voice telling her to go back.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reports lifelong astral projection while awake before the NDE; after the event reports precognition, locating missing children, and sensing spirits; reports past-life death by drowning recalled after waking in semi-coma.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I love you Paula, you have to go back.”
